title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-cost ways for current Lipscomb students to move, exercise, and spend time together through Campus Recreation.

cards.title: Lift Together in the SAC Weight Room
cards.subtitle: A no-cost current-student workout hang
cards.notes: Bring your Lipscomb student ID, choose a shared workout plan, and rotate equipment with friends in the SAC weight room.
cards.short_summary: Turn a regular strength session into an easy, purchase-free meetup with classmates.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb states that the Student Activities Center includes a weight room and that current students may use SAC facilities free with a student ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for current Lipscomb University students; bring a student ID to scan at the Student Activities Center entrance.

cards.title: Meet for Open Gym Time
cards.subtitle: Free indoor court time for current students
cards.notes: Gather a small group for casual shooting or court play, then check Campus Recreation procedures before organizing a larger event.
cards.short_summary: Use the SAC gymnasium for an informal, weatherproof group activity without buying admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb identifies the gymnasium as a Campus Recreation facility and says use of the Student Activities Center is free for current students.
cards.access_notes: Current Lipscomb students enter the SAC free with student ID; organized activities or events may require advance facility approval.

cards.title: Play a Racquetball Round
cards.subtitle: A free SAC court hang for current students
cards.notes: Invite one or two friends for a racquetball session and confirm court availability with Campus Recreation before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A compact court game offers a social alternative to a solo gym routine at no additional cost.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb describes the Student Activities Center as having racquetball courts and states that SAC use is free for current students with ID.
cards.access_notes: Free with a current Lipscomb student ID; verify court availability and any reservation requirement through Campus Recreation.

cards.title: Walk Laps and Catch Up
cards.subtitle: A no-cost indoor walking meetup
cards.notes: Set an easy lap goal, bring a classmate, and use the SAC walking track for conversation without needing to order anything.
cards.short_summary: An indoor walk makes a simple social break between classes, regardless of outdoor weather.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says the Student Activities Center contains running or walking tracks and is free for current students who present student ID.
cards.access_notes: Available without an added charge to current Lipscomb students; scan a student ID at the SAC entrance.

cards.title: Run Social Laps Indoors
cards.subtitle: Free current-student track time in the SAC
cards.notes: Pair up for a conversational run or interval session, adjusting pace so everyone in the group can participate comfortably.
cards.short_summary: The indoor track supports a shared run without a race registration or fitness-class fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb identifies running or walking tracks in the Student Activities Center and explicitly says SAC use is free with current student ID.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current Lipscomb students using student ID; consult Campus Recreation for facility availability.

cards.entity_name: Student Activities Center Functional Fitness Room
cards.title: Build a Group Circuit
cards.subtitle: A free functional-fitness meetup
cards.notes: Create a short bodyweight circuit with friends, leave space for other users, and follow all posted equipment and room rules.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative circuit gives the group a structured activity without paying for a private studio.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb lists a functional fitness room among Campus Recreation facilities and says Student Activities Center use has no cost for current students.
cards.access_notes: Free for current Lipscomb students with student ID; check Campus Recreation guidance before arranging an organized group practice.

cards.title: Take Hip Hop Fitness Together
cards.subtitle: A free scheduled group-fitness class
cards.notes: Check the semester schedule, invite a friend, and arrive prepared to follow the instructor through the full movement session.
cards.short_summary: This instructor-led class combines a social meetup and active break with no additional student charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb names Hip Hop Fitness among the group fitness classes open to all students and states that group fitness classes are free for current students.
cards.access_notes: For current Lipscomb students at no added cost; consult the current semester schedule before attending.

cards.title: Share a HIIT Session
cards.subtitle: No-cost instructor-led interval training
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled class that fits everyone, arrive early enough to settle in, and scale movements to your own comfort level.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled HIIT class supplies the workout plan, making it easy for friends to exercise together.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb lists HIIT as a group fitness option available to all students and says its group fitness classes are free for current students.
cards.access_notes: Free for current Lipscomb students; attendance depends on the group fitness schedule published each semester.

cards.title: Reset at a Yoga Class
cards.subtitle: A free group-fitness pause with friends
cards.notes: Find the current class time, meet your group beforehand, and bring any personal gear requested by Campus Recreation.
cards.short_summary: A guided yoga session creates a quieter shared activity between academic commitments.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb identifies Yoga as one of the group fitness classes all students may attend and confirms those classes are free for current students.
cards.access_notes: No additional cost for current Lipscomb students; verify the semester schedule and participation instructions before arrival.

cards.title: Ride Side by Side at Spin
cards.subtitle: A free scheduled indoor cycling class
cards.notes: Confirm the current session time, coordinate with friends, and arrive soon enough to follow the instructor's setup directions.
cards.short_summary: A guided indoor ride gives classmates a shared challenge without purchasing a studio class.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb names Spin among the fitness classes available to all students and says group fitness classes are free for current Lipscomb students.
cards.access_notes: Free to current Lipscomb students; check the semester group-fitness schedule before planning the meetup.
